nodes.rationale: Proposed split of work by layer across 4 people (A backend auth/wallet/tx, B backend db/NBP/tests/devops, C mobile, D docs then mobile); priorities P0-P3.

nodes.label: task_018: Atomic buy/sell currency transaction
nodes.rationale: Rate fetched server-side, not from client; both balances + transaction record in one DB transaction with row lock/concurrency token.

nodes.label: Exchange Data Consistency
nodes.rationale: Currency exchange and corresponding balance changes must be performed consistently (atomically).

nodes.label: No Plaintext Credentials
nodes.rationale: User credentials must not be stored in plaintext.

nodes.label: No Secrets in Source/Repo
nodes.rationale: Keys and passwords must not be in source code or public repo.

nodes.label: Server-side Balance & Transaction Logic
nodes.rationale: Mobile app must not determine or modify user funds; all balance logic lives on the server.

nodes.label: Transaction Rate Snapshot (section 4)
nodes.rationale: Rate applied must be stored with the transaction so later rate changes do not alter historical data.

nodes.label: db service (postgres:17, kantor-db)
nodes.rationale: Password required from .env (fails if unset); healthcheck via pg_isready; persistent db-data volume.
